Northbridge Institute of Technology — admissions office · how to apply

English language requirements

Applicants whose first language is not English must demonstrate English language proficiency.

Accepted tests

We require an IELTS minimum overall band of 7.0, with no section below 6.5. The TOEFL iBT minimum is 100.
